purpose: Profile-B celastrol/tripterine nanoparticle formulation PRESET library (Stage-2 research artifact). A preset = a complete, experimentally-defined formulation package. Users select among presets; they do NOT freely combine excipients. NOT a Stage-3 implementation. No fabricated values.
provenance_rule: id_status VERIFIED_FULLTEXT = primary opened in this project; IDENTIFIED_SEARCH = bibliographic identity from web search, values NOT verified (do not use numbers as data); SECONDARY_REVIEW = review-reported. Search-summary numbers are recorded as 'search_reported_UNVERIFIED', never as parameters.

api_identity.name: celastrol

well_established_properties.aqueous_solubility: poorly water-soluble (consensus across reviews PMC7751759, PMC10904542) - exact value pending primary
well_established_properties.chemical_stability: unstable under aqueous/physiological/oxidative conditions; Michael-acceptor quinone methide reacts with thiols
well_established_properties.why_nanoparticle: encapsulation used to overcome poor solubility, instability, narrow therapeutic window and toxicity

api_identity.note: Physicochemical NUMBERS (solubility mg/mL, logP, degradation %) NOT recorded here - search returned figures but no primary opened. See data/profile-b-solubility-registry.json for the honest gap.

presets.name: Surface-charged topical celastrol NLC (Chen 2012)
presets.family_note: ONE preset family with THREE surface-charge configurations (cationic/neutral/anionic). NOT three size choices - sizes 84.5-90.2 nm are too close to be distinct options.

composition_Table1_mg.common: solid:liquid lipid 3:1; +Pluronic F68 aqueous; 15 mg tripterine
composition_Table1_mg.critical_caveat: surface charge is CONFOUNDED with lipid identity - cationic uses stearylamine, neutral uses glyceryl behenate, anionic uses Precirol ATO-5. Charge differences are NOT isolated causal effects.

presets.surfactant_stabilizer: soybean lecithin (emulsifier) + TPGS (d-alpha-tocopheryl PEG succinate; surfactant/stabilizer) + Pluronic F68; all held constant across the 3 configs
presets.manufacturing: solvent evaporation (drug+lipids in acetone/ethanol -> aqueous Pluronic F68)
presets.particle_size_display: approximately 85-90 nm (do NOT expose a size selector for 84.5/87.8/90.2 nm)
presets.api_state: AMORPHOUS / molecularly dispersed in the NLC (DSC: tripterine melting peaks 175.7/211.4 C absent in the NLC) - low intra-carrier crystallization risk

release.label: dialysis-APPARENT release (MWCO 8-14 kDa, 2:8 EtOH:PBS pH7.4) - membrane transport not separable from true carrier release

permeation.tissue: Sprague-Dawley RAT full-thickness abdominal skin, Franz cell

presets.efficacy: B16BL6 melanoma-bearing C57BL/6 mice; cationic NLC highest antimelanoma efficacy (P<0.05)

stability.crystallization: S1 (amorphous state -> low intra-carrier crystallization risk)
stability.storage_claim: 'limited drug leakage during storage' = generic NLC claim, NOT a measured time-series

presets.precipitation: not investigated in Chen; released-celastrol precipitation is a RISK (poorly soluble) but no compatible onset-time data
presets.package_reconciliation: Frozen package B1 uses abstract-level values and marks PDI/zeta/release-% NOT REPORTED; size/EE use abstract ordering. See data/profile-b-evidence-package.json.

presets.name: Celastrol+Indomethacin transdermal NLC (rheumatoid arthritis)
presets.source: Zhang et al. Transdermal delivery system of NLC loaded with Celastrol and Indomethacin: optimization, characterization and efficacy for rheumatoid arthritis. (tandfonline)
presets.api: celastrol + indomethacin (COMBINATION - not a single-API celastrol preset)
presets.distinguishing_feature: much smaller (~27 nm) vs Chen ~85-90 nm; combination drug; different disease (RA, not melanoma)
presets.why_candidate: genuinely different size region + carrier optimization; but COMBINATION formulation - not directly comparable to single-API celastrol
presets.preset_status: DEACTIVATED - not in frozen evidence package; not a selectable simulator preset (research candidate only)

presets.name: ER-targeting celastrol PLGA/DSPE-PEG nanoparticle (melanoma immunotherapy)
presets.source: Nanoparticle-mediated celastrol ER targeting delivery amplify immunogenic cell death in melanoma (Bioactive Materials / ScienceDirect S2090123224002480, 2024)
presets.distinguishing_feature: polymeric (not lipid) carrier; ER-targeting ligand (TSE); immunogenic cell death mechanism; different ROUTE from Chen
presets.why_candidate: same disease (melanoma) but different carrier class + route + mechanism; a real distinct system
presets.preset_status: CANDIDATE - pending full text; different route (systemic) than the topical Profile-B core
presets.corrected_identity_by_package: Wang F et al. J Adv Res 2025;71:585-601, DOI 10.1016/j.jare.2024.06.011 = frozen preset B2 (ER-targeting; physicochemical fields NOT REPORTED)

presets.name: HA redox-responsive celastrol polymeric micelle + folic acid (breast cancer)
presets.source: Tumor-targeting and redox dual-responsive hyaluronic acid-based polymeric micelles loaded with celastrol for breast cancer (ScienceDirect S014181302507922X)
presets.carrier: HA-based redox-responsive polymeric micelle; folic-acid targeting
presets.distinguishing_feature: hyaluronic-acid coating + redox-responsive + folic-acid ligand; ~120 nm (larger); systemic
presets.preset_status: DEACTIVATED - not in frozen evidence package; not a selectable simulator preset (research candidate only)

presets.name: Celastrol polymeric mixed micelle (breast cancer, spatial targeting)
presets.source: Celastrol-loaded polymeric mixed micelles shows improved antitumor efficacy in 4T1 xenograft through spatial targeting (ScienceDirect S037851732400468X)
presets.preset_status: DEACTIVATED - not in frozen evidence package; not a selectable simulator preset (research candidate only)

supporting_not_a_delivery_preset.name: Celastrol-beta-cyclodextrin (SBE-betaCD) inclusion complex
supporting_not_a_delivery_preset.source: Enhanced solubility, stability, permeation and anti-cancer efficacy of Celastrol-beta-cyclodextrin inclusion complex (ScienceDirect S0167732220338319)
supporting_not_a_delivery_preset.role: solubility/stability ENHANCER (molecular complex, not a nanoparticle) - useful for the solubility/precipitation registry, NOT a nanoparticle preset
supporting_not_a_delivery_preset.search_reported_UNVERIFIED: solubility increased ~30-fold; degradation reduced (values pending full text)

discovery_reviews.citation: Recent advances in drug delivery of celastrol for enhancing efficiency and reducing the toxicity. Front Pharmacol 2024.
discovery_reviews.role: discovery/secondary only - do not extract numbers as data

discovery_reviews.citation: Celastrol: A Review of Useful Strategies Overcoming its Limitation in Anticancer Application. Front Pharmacol 2020;11:558741.

selection_summary.verified_note: Only P1 (Chen 2012) is full-text-verified = a complete, usable preset family (3 surface configs).
selection_summary.candidate_note: P2-P5 are REAL, distinct celastrol NP systems (literature genuinely supports >=5 distinct systems) but are search-identified only - full texts required before they become usable presets.
selection_summary.honest_statement: The literature supports the EXISTENCE of at least five scientifically distinct celastrol nanoparticle systems, but only ONE (Chen NLC, topical melanoma) is verified here. Do not present P2-P5 numbers as data until their PDFs are opened.
